headline: Kenyan Prosecutors Drop Criminal Case Against FlexPay in Naivas Dispute
summary: Kenyan prosecutors reversed their decision to charge four FlexPay executives, determining that a KES 31.2 million dispute with Naivas is a civil matter rather than a criminal offense.
why: Clarifying the legal boundaries between civil commercial disputes and criminal charges in fintech partnerships reduces regulatory uncertainty for local startups.

impacts.name: FlexPay
impacts.why: Dropping criminal charges removes legal overhang for the executives and company operations.
